title: SQLite column affinity changes conversion on both sides of equal sign
summary: Column affinity affects conversion before comparison. Comparing two literals can give a different result from comparing the same values in a column.
applies: SQLite query results and crossing dialect boundaries
detail: After writing 42 to the ordinary table t(x TEXT), x=42 can be true; the independent expression '42'=42 can be false.
boundary: Storage classes, column affinities, and expression affinities should be distinguished, and strict tables cannot eliminate all expression differences.
relevance: Explains why the same displayed value can produce different results in different query expressions.
